description: Origami tracing practice on Rokid glasses: 8 works with 63 modelled fold steps (canvas-drawn fold diagrams, current crease brightest green), spoken step tips, fold on real paper and hold each step up for a photo check of three coarse items only (outline shape, extra or missing edges, crease direction), learner override, resume-where-you-stopped and cross-session progress.
name: Trace Origami
